close_reason: Fixed all 5 failing NC tests: URI host semantics (test 36), DN intersection with more-specific constraints (test 12), incompatible DN intersection (test 13), DN+RFC822 type-aware intersection (tests 28/29), emailAddress-in-subject check (test 29). Full workspace passes, clippy clean.
description:
Five categories of NC matching bugs identified by §4.13 PKITS tests:

1. DN subtree permitted match: uses exact equality instead of RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 subtree (prefix) matching. Affects tests 1, 4, 5, 6, 11, 14, 27.

2. DN excluded subtree check: not triggering when there are no permittedSubtrees (only excludedSubtrees). Affects tests 7, 8, 9, 15, 16.

3. RFC 822 domain suffix: .domain syntax not matched. Affects tests 21, 23.

4. DNS subdomain: exact match only, not suffix match. Affects test 30.

5. URI host extraction: full URI string compared instead of extracting host for NC check. Affects test 34.

All affected tests are marked #[ignore] in pkits_4_13.rs with tracking reference PKIX-nc-matching.
title: Fix NameConstraints matching bugs found by §4.13 PKITS tests
